is_anopheles.evidence: The paper is a broad review on repellent technologies; while it mentions Anopheles in the text and literature references (e.g., page 5, 8), it does not sample or genotype Anopheles populations.

reports_target_markers.evidence: No target resistance markers are genotyped. Knockdown resistance (kdr) is only mentioned in passing when citing previously published literature on Aedes aegypti (page 7).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: There are no genotype or allele counts or frequencies reported anywhere in the paper.

african_field_population.evidence: No African field populations of mosquitoes are collected or tested for resistance markers.

is_primary_study.evidence: The paper is explicitly labeled as a 'Review' (page 1) surveying repellent technologies and modes of action.

sub_country_location.evidence: No primary mosquito collection sites are studied.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No mosquito collection dates/years are reported.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Not applicable; this is a review paper.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary data needed; paper is fundamentally ineligible as a review.

assessment.summary: This article is a review focusing on contact and spatial repellent technologies for mosquito-borne disease control, mechanisms of action, and novel biorational chemistries. It does not perform primary empirical genotyping of insecticide-resistance markers in African Anopheles field populations.
exclusion_reasons: Review article (not a primary empirical study)
Does not genotype target insecticide resistance markers
No African field mosquito populations tested
